catCompanionRules: Do not add a cat Companion in this batch.
Do not infer, imitate, or pre-empt the player's Portrait identity.
Do not export a standalone animal, pose set, identity board, or reusable Portrait from a companion scene.
allCompanionRules: Use only the explicitly listed species and count for each rare variant.
Keep companions subtle and visually secondary to both landmark and future player Portrait.
Companions must remain outside safeBounds and must not obscure landmark recognition points.

globalConstraints: Every ordinary variant contains no cat, animal, person, date, postmark, caption, logo, watermark, readable sign, pseudo-text, UI, slot frame, or anchor mark.
A rare variant contains only its explicitly authorized Companion and no player cat or substitute Portrait.
Use primary or official visual sources for factual landmark geometry and layout, record provenance and rights notes, and do not retain restricted source photographs.
Keep the landmark immediately recognizable and preserve defining proportions and structural relationships.
Reserve an unobstructed, low-detail, low-contrast Portrait slot away from landmark recognition points and future copy and postmark zones.

Use locked B intensity: thin warm gray-brown linework, low-saturation sage green, ochre, faded vermilion, generous negative space, subtle warm-white paper texture, restrained watercolor bleed, and quiet nostalgia.
Avoid photorealism, 3D, flat vector art, neon, high saturation, hard digital gradients, thick black outlines, crowded backgrounds, malformed architecture or anatomy, and copied source-photo pixels.

variants.brief: Representative quiet daytime view of El Castillo with its stepped pyramid geometry, central stairways, square summit temple, and open limestone plaza immediately readable.
Soft late-afternoon view with restrained warm stone and long low shadows while preserving El Castillo's nine terraces, axial stairs, and summit temple.
Quiet plaza-edge view with exactly one tiny Yucatan jay on a lateral stone, outside the Portrait slot and secondary to El Castillo.
Representative quiet view emerging from the Siq toward Al-Khazneh, preserving the rose-rock facade's two-storey classical order, central tholos, urn, and enclosing canyon walls.
Soft amber light reaching Al-Khazneh through the shaded Siq, with restrained rose sandstone and the facade's columns, pediments, tholos, and urn clearly legible.
Representative calm daytime view across the reflecting basin with Angkor Wat's five-tower quincunx silhouette, layered galleries, causeway, and tropical tree line coherent.
Muted dawn with pale gold and lotus-pond reflections, keeping the five sanctuary towers and long horizontal gallery silhouette unmistakable without crowds.
Quiet causeway-edge view with exactly one small long-tailed macaque seated on a lateral stone outside the Portrait slot and secondary to the temple.
Representative calm daytime view across Milford Sound toward Mitre Peak, preserving the steep pyramidal summit, dark sheer fiord walls, quiet water, and restrained native shoreline.
Soft misty early light over Mitre Peak and the fiord, with pale reflections, layered cliffs, and the iconic pyramidal silhouette remaining clear.
Quiet rocky shoreline view with exactly one small kea on a lateral boulder outside the Portrait slot and secondary to Mitre Peak.
Representative quiet daytime view across the Ounila valley toward Ait Benhaddou, preserving the stepped earthen ksar, corner towers, crenellations, hillside crown, and sparse riverbed.
Restrained late-afternoon view with warm ochre earthen walls and long soft shadows, keeping the clustered kasbah towers and hill-climbing silhouette coherent.
